name: Sesame oil
description: Sesame oil (CAS 8008-74-0 ) is a fixed vegetable oil cold-pressed or solvent-extracted from Sesamum indicum seeds. It functions as an edible cooking oil, a skin-conditioning emollient, and a pharmaceutical carrier across food, cosmetic, and healthcare manufacturing. In food production, it is used as a finishing oil and flavor ingredient in sauces, dressings, marinades, and snack seasonings. This is particularly common in Asian cuisine applications where its characteristic roasted profile is a formulation requirement. Cosmetic formulators incorporate it into facial oils, body lotions, lip balms, and hair care products for its skin-softening and moisture-retention properties. It provides a natural barrier that helps maintain hydration in various topical applications. In pharmaceutical manufacturing, it serves as a lipophilic excipient and vehicle for oil-based injectable formulations, topical preparations, and softgel fill compounds. It also functions as a release agent and lubricant in food processing equipment. Sesame oil is supplied as a clear to amber liquid, with refined and unrefined grades available to suit different application requirements. Standard specifications include food-grade, USP , and BP grades for industrial use. Refined grades typically meet stricter color and odor thresholds for pharmaceutical and cosmetic use.
